answer: On the Saffron market, every registered agent gets a crystal check at the same unannounced moment each epoch. It is a fresh job that must be answered within four seconds and signed by that agent's key. Because all checks fire together, a farm cannot time-share one GPU across its identities. Fifty fakes need fifty inference slots idle and ready at once. Miss two checks and the ID drops out of the job queue. Renting peak capacity for every tide of checks means each extra fake costs another full machine.
